title: Distinguish proposed behavior from observed architecture
goal: Assess architecture facts without mistaking proposed behavior for implementation.
context: The selected model includes proposed and observed runtime information.
trigger: The reviewer examines a Process detail.
preconditions: The selected scope and any available project or artifact identity are explicitly identified.

Shows qualification, accountable owner and source basis for each selected fact.

alternatives.outcome: Qualification and source identity keep them distinguishable.

failures.outcome: The view reports the gap instead of fabricating ordering or satisfaction.
